title: Psychedelic Alien Encounter
description: A curly-haired man in dark clothing stands in a dramatic pose with arms crossed, surrounded by vibrant, swirling psychedelic patterns in a night sky. A glowing blue portal containing a green alien head floats to his left, while a red moon, a multi-tiered pagoda, and a purple mountain appear in the background.
prompt: A dramatic scene of a curly-haired man in dark robes standing with arms crossed in a powerful pose, floating within a vibrant psychedelic landscape of swirling colorful smoke and vortex patterns in teal, purple, orange and green. To his left a glowing blue circular portal reveals a green alien head. In the background a giant blood-red moon illuminates a traditional Japanese pagoda and purple mountains. Highly detailed surreal psychedelic art with flowing energy ribbons and cosmic patterns.
